sources.title: RavichandranJ/Dolphin3-Cyber-8B-GGUF - toolify.ai
sources.snippet: 🌟 Overview Dolphin3-Cyber-8B is a domain-specific large language model fine-tuned exclusively for cybersecurity applications. Built on top of the powerful Dolphin3.-Llama3.1-8B-abliterated base model, this model has been enhanced with specialized security knowledge to serve as an AI-powered cybersecurity assistant.
